summary: Skyasterix streams his team preparations and gear tuning for the Season 9 Crown Battle and Grave dungeon speedruns. He adjusts stats such as Accuracy, Skill Haste, and Defense across various Frost and Poison team compositions. Throughout the stream, he tests these comps against Grave bosses including Deadly Harpy, Blood Prince Xenos, Colossal Scavenger, Dead Phoenix, and Soul Devourer, as well as the Fire Guardian. He also highlights the importance of timing debuffs like Defense Down and reminds players about the upcoming Aura Selected Summons event.

meta_changes: Season 9 Crown Contest requires fine-tuned stat builds and precise Skill Haste/Accuracy thresholds for reliable boss clears.
tips: Ensure your debuffers have sufficient Accuracy to guarantee land rate on essential debuffs like Defense Down.
Carefully tune hero Skill Haste and Speed so debuffs apply immediately before your primary damage dealers launch their ultimate abilities.
Save summon resources for the upcoming Aura Selected Summons event if you plan to strengthen Aura-based teams.
